questions.cardText:
[Engineering and Invention] What is the most efficient way to replace the air in a room with a window using a fan?
A. Blowing air into the room from the window
B. Blowing air out of the room through the window
C. Blowing air across the room with a fan
Answer: B. Blowing air out of a room through a window creates negative pressure inside the room. This negative pressure draws fresh air through any available openings, such as under doors or through small gaps in windows, ensuring a more complete exchange of air.
questions.de: In welche Richtung sollte ein Ventilator im Fenster blasen, um die Luft eines Raumes am effizientesten auszutauschen?
questions.en: To replace the air in a room most efficiently with a fan in the window, which way should the fan blow?
questions.answerEn: Out of the room (as an exhaust)

timeline.labelEn: Schuyler Wheeler invents the electric fan (between 1882 and 1886)
timeline.labelDe: Schuyler Wheeler erfindet den elektrischen Ventilator (zwischen 1882 und 1886)

source.title: Does Pointing a Fan Out the Window Work?

questions.notes: EngineerFix: exhaust creates negative pressure that pulls replacement air in from every opening, far more efficient at replacing room air than intake or circulation; intake is better only when outside air is much cooler. Works best with a second opening. Timeline from Wikipedia 'Fan (machine)'.

questions.cardText:
[Astronomy] What is the name of the largest moon of Saturn?
A. Europa
B. Titan
C. Ganymede
Answer: B.
